title: gnomAD allele frequencies at chip loci
description: How common each allele is in gnomAD v2.1.1 genomes, overall and per genetic-ancestry group. A sampled estimate: frequencies depend on who was sampled. Pre-filtered to consumer-chip positions.
citation: Karczewski KJ et al. The mutational constraint spectrum quantified from variation in 141,456 humans. Nature 2020;581:434–443
